blurb: Delaware Valley Opera's productions and concerts are made possible by the New York State Council on the Arts with the support of the Office of the Governor and the New York State Legislature. The DVO is committed to hiring performers and technical staff from diverse racial, ethnic, socio-economic, religious and gender backgrounds, and encourages those from under-represented populations to apply or audition.
